study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Italinna et al., PLoS Comput Biol, 2023
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using normative modeling and machine learning for detecting mild traumatic brain injury from magnetoencephalography data

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Cam-CAN (Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience) dataset; Single-site dataset from Aalto University (Kaltiainen and colleagues).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: A large open neuroimaging dataset by the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN) [29]... We employed a dataset originally measured by Kaltiainen and colleagues [27,28], comprising resting-state MEG recordings from 25 mild traumatic injury patients and 20 healthy controls.
